about: The user asked whether orbit's default can become one program pull request per architecture doc. Today a project that sets nothing gets no pull requests at all, and G0 says a default install behaves exactly as it does now except where the user has ratified an exception.
question: Which default do you mean: what orbit init writes into a new project's settings (existing projects unchanged), what a project that sets nothing gets (existing projects change on upgrade), or only your own projects' settings with no change to orbit?

defines.definition: the command that sets orbit up in a project and writes its settings file
